slots.title: U.S. session recap — Sept. 17, 2026
slots.body:
Major U.S. indexes closed higher on Sept. 17.
The S&P 500 finished at 7,637.05, up 85.24 points (+1.1%), with an intraday range of 7,611.81 to 7,646.86.
The Nasdaq Composite outpaced the broad market at 26,418.30, up 439.87 points (+1.7%).

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 316.14 points to 51,778.04 (+0.6%).
The Russell 2000 gained 15.82 points to 2,874.63 (+0.6%).
The session came one day after the Federal Reserve’s rate increase; Barron’s and other coverage described stocks climbing sharply higher in that context.

Labor data printed at 12:30 ET.
Initial jobless claims registered 196,000 versus a 208,000 estimate and 206,000 previously.
Continuing claims were 1.730 million versus 1.780 million expected.
The four-week average for initial claims was 203.25 thousand.
Atlanta Fed GDPNow for Q3 was unchanged at 5.1%.

Housing figures from the same release window showed August housing starts at a 1.275 million annual rate versus 1.31 million expected, with month-over-month housing starts at -2.6%.
Building permits were 1.394 million with permits down 2.7% month over month versus a -1.6% estimate.

Sector performance on NASDAQ grouped averages showed Energy leading at +2.1%, Healthcare +0.5%, and Technology +0.5%.
Basic Materials lagged at -0.6%, Utilities -0.4%, and Consumer Defensive -0.4%.

Large technology and consumer internet names carried the equity tape in the megacap set.
Amazon closed at 251.19 (+2.1%).
Apple at 337.00 (+1.4%).
Microsoft at 497.75 (+1.5%).
NVIDIA at 219.34 (+2.5%).
Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM) at 430.26 (+3.0%).
ASML at 1,629.67 (+1.7%).
Salesforce was an outlier to the downside at 242.85 (-3.1%).
Intel, among actives, closed at 108.80 (+7.7%).

The CBOE Volatility Index fell 2.27 points to 15.44 (-12.8%), with a session low of 15.38 and high of 16.29, alongside the equity advance.

Treasury yields in the injected snapshot (dated Sept. 15) showed the 10-year at 5.0% and the 2-year at 4.7%, for a 2s10s spread of 0.33 percentage points.

Gold futures (GCUSD) settled at 4,386.00, down 13.70 (-0.3%).
Brent crude (BZUSD) was 104.11 (-0.7%).
The U.S. Oil Fund (USO) closed at 155.31 (-0.6%).
The dollar proxy UUP finished at 28.38 (-0.1%).
Bitcoin (BTCUSD) was 77,105.41 (+1.0%).

Overseas indexes in the bundle also closed up: FTSE 100 +1.2% to 10,816.14, Nikkei 225 +0.8% to 64,662.11, Hang Seng +0.7% to 24,782.15.
The iShares MSCI Germany ETF (EWG), labeled DAX in the feed, was 42.69 (+0.6%).

slots.body:
